n, K, mod = map(int, input().split())

def qpow(base, exp):
    res = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return res

def comb(i, j):
    return c[i] * invC[j] % mod * invC[i - j] % mod

# Read input
# n, K, mod are already read above

if n & 1:
    print(qpow(K, n))
    exit()

c = [1] * (n + 1)
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    c[i] = c[i - 1] * i % mod

invC = [1] * (n + 1)
invC[n] = qpow(c[n], mod - 2)
for i in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
    invC[i] = invC[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod

cnt = [0] * (n + 1)
mx = [0] * (n + 1)

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(19):
        if (1 << j) & i:
            cnt[i] += 1

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in reversed(range(19)):
        if (1 << j) & i:
            mx[i] = 1 << j
            break

dp = [[0] * 20 for _ in range(n + 1)]
dp[0][0] = 1

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    if (n & i) != i:
        continue
    rem = i ^ mx[i]
    mask = rem
    while True:
        cur = mask + mx[i]
        c2 = i ^ cur
        limit = min(K - 1, cnt[c2])
        tmpVal = comb(i, cur)
        for j in range(limit + 1):
            dp[i][j + 1] = (dp[i][j + 1] + dp[c2][j] * tmpVal) % mod
        if mask == 0:
            break
        mask = (mask - 1) & rem

ans = 0
for j in range(1, min(cnt[n], K) + 1):
    ans = (ans + dp[n][j] * comb(K, j) % mod * c[j]) % mod

ans = (qpow(K, n) - ans + mod) % mod
print(ans)
